Why Choose
N.S. Agricultural College
✓
Hands-on Agriculture Education
Education goes beyond textbooks — students gain practical experience in agriculture, natural resource management, and land use, preparing them for entry-level positions as well as advanced careers in agriculture.
✓
Ideal Location for Learning
Situated in Markapur, in the western part of Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh, the college provides exposure to diversified agricultural practices unique to this region.
✓
Exposure to Diverse Crops
Students encounter a wide variety of crops — cereals, pulses, oilseeds, cash crops, and various horticultural crops — reflecting the rich agricultural diversity of Andhra Pradesh.
✓
Extensive Farm Infrastructure
Spread over 110 acres, the college farm allows students to gain hands-on knowledge in crop cultivation, cropping patterns, water and land management, and sustainable farming practices.
✓
Well-furnished Laboratories & Library
Well-furnished laboratories under different disciplines equip students with practical knowledge and exposure to modern equipment, while a well-stocked library fosters self-study, critical thinking, and research.

Eligibility & Selection Criteria
Particulars
B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
Qualifying Examination
Intermediate / Diploma in Agriculture
Entrance Examination
EAPCET / AGRICET
Age Limit
17 years completed as on 31st December of the year of admission; upper limit 22 years (25 for SC & ST, 27 for physically challenged)
Under the EAPCET quota, students are admitted based on their performance in the state-level Common Entrance Test (EAPCET) conducted during the year of admission by the AP State Council of Higher Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh.
40% of the seats are reserved for candidates from families of agriculturists owning not less than 1 acre of land, who have studied for a minimum of 6 years in schools located in non-municipal areas.
Fee is paid at the time of counselling (admission) through online transfer or in cash; in subsequent semesters, fees are paid online through the ANGRAU Payment Gateway.
2
Step-by-Step Admission Process
1
University Notification
ANGRAU invites applications from eligible candidates through notifications in leading newspapers and the University website, generally in the month of June. Admissions are through online and offline modes.
2
Entrance Examination
Intermediate (10+2) students appear for EAPCET, conducted by the AP State Council of Higher Education. Diploma in Agriculture students appear for AGRICET, conducted by ANGRAU, Lam, Guntur.
3
Counselling & Fee Payment
Admission is based on entrance performance. Fee is paid by the student at the time of counselling (admission) through online transfer or in cash.
4
First Registration & Orientation
Admitted students receive registration guidelines from the Associate Dean on arrival at the college. A registration and orientation programme is conducted for first-time students; attendance is reckoned from the date of registration.
5
Registration in Subsequent Semesters
Students register in person for the courses offered for their batch, producing their identity card at the registration centre. Payment of fee and other dues (college, department, hostel, library) precedes registration; semester fees are paid online through the ANGRAU Payment Gateway.
As per the ICAR VI Deans Committee curriculum, multiple entry and exit options are also available for students in the UG programme in Agriculture.
3
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I apply for admission?
+
As NS Agricultural College is affiliated to Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University, Guntur, admissions are conducted through the University. The University invites applications from eligible candidates through notifications published in leading newspapers and the University website, generally in the month of June.
What are the eligibility criteria regarding academic qualification?
+
Applicants must have successfully completed their 10+2 (Intermediate) or Diploma in Agriculture from a recognized board or institution.
Are there any entrance examinations required?
+
Yes. EAPCET — students who completed 10+2 (Intermediate) are admitted under the EAPCET quota and must appear for the state-level Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test conducted by the Government of Andhra Pradesh. AGRICET — students who completed a Diploma in Agriculture are admitted under the AGRICET quota, conducted by ANGRAU, Lam, Guntur.
Does the institute have sufficient teaching faculty?
+
NS Agricultural College is accredited by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), New Delhi, and maintains sufficient qualified faculty as per ICAR recommendations. Faculty strength is reviewed regularly by the affiliated State Agricultural University — ANGRAU, Lam, Guntur.
What are the class timings?
+
Regular classes are conducted Monday to Saturday (second Saturday of every month is a holiday), generally from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
When are holidays given?
+
The college follows the ANGRAU academic calendar. All Sundays are holidays, the second Saturday of every month is a holiday, all public holidays declared by the Government of Andhra Pradesh are observed, and a semester break is provided after each semester.
Are students eligible for fee reimbursement by the State Government?
+
Yes. Students of NS Agricultural College are eligible for the Andhra Pradesh fee reimbursement scheme, subject to fulfillment of the prescribed eligibility criteria.
What is the fee payment schedule?
+
Tuition fees are generally paid on a semester basis (twice a year).
Can I pay my fees in installments?
+
No. Tuition fees must be paid online through the University gateway portal before the last date of registration for the respective semester, as prescribed by ANGRAU.
Are hostel accommodation and mess facilities available?
+
Yes. Separate on-campus hostel and mess facilities are available for both male and female students.
Are recreational and sports facilities available on campus?
+
Yes. The campus features a well-equipped gymnasium, recreation rooms in hostels, athletic tracks, and courts for various indoor and outdoor sports, along with a well-established cultural centre and ten student clubs encouraging active participation in extracurricular activities.
